triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_legacy_bz_inventory_change AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.inventory FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_legacy_bz_inventory_change()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_reconcile_inventory_reserve AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.material_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reconcile_inventory_reserve()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reconcile_inventory_reserve()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  -- Перераховуємо для старого товару (при оновленні або видаленні накладної)
  if (tg_op = 'UPDATE' or tg_op = 'DELETE') and old.inventory_id is not null then
    update public.inventory
    set reserved_qty = coalesce((
      select sum(quantity)
      from public.material_requests
      where inventory_id = old.inventory_id and status = 'issued'
    ), 0),
    updated_at = now()
    where id = old.inventory_id;
  end if;

  -- Перераховуємо для нового товару (при додаванні або оновленні накладної)
  if (tg_op = 'INSERT' or tg_op = 'UPDATE') and new.inventory_id is not null then
    update public.inventory
    set reserved_qty = coalesce((
      select sum(quantity)
      from public.material_requests
      where inventory_id = new.inventory_id and status = 'issued'
    ), 0),
    updated_at = now()
    where id = new.inventory_id;
  end if;

  return null;
end;
$function$
